venues.name: Greensboro Complex

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Greensboro Complex website: www.goscomplex.com Greensboro Complex Advance Information Line (automated): 336-373-7474 Greensboro Complex Administrative Offices: 336-373-7400
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: First Horizon Coliseum Ticket Office Hours of operation: Thursday thru Saturday, 12:00 pm - 5:00 pm. Summer Hours may apply. The dedicated facility box offices open 30 minutes to 2 hours prior depending on event.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: American Express, Visa, MasterCard or Discover Card. A valid matching ID is required for credit card purchases.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Location at venue: Located at each venue box office. Hours of Operation: Varies based on event. Other Information: An ID matching the person picking up the tickets as well as the name on the account, the credit card used to purchase the tickets and an order number are required for pick-up.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking Location: The Greensboro Complex maintains parking spaces in paved, lighted and managed parking lots on site at the facility. 4,800 spaces are located in the main parking lot accessible by entering the parking gates from Ellington Street and Patterson Avenue and are closest to the Amphitheater. Additional parking spaces are located in front of The Terrace and across Gate City Blvd Parking Lot at the northeast corner of Gate City Blvd and Coliseum Boulevard. RV Parking: For certain events, overnight RV parking is permitted. Space is subject to available and limited. Call 336-373-7492 to request availability and rates. Price (if applicable): Parking is charged based on the type of event scheduled and ranges from $5 to $50 per space utilized. Parking lot attendants are on duty during major events to help direct patrons with appropriate credentials to handicap and reserved spaces and to assist with regular car, RV and bus parking. RV and bus parking is charged by the number of spaces occupied. Approximate # of Parking spaces: 4,800+ on-site parking spaces are available in paved, lighted and managed parking lots. Handicapped parking (availability/location): Handicap parking spaces are located in front of each venue and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Handicap van parking spaces are marked. Handicap parking spaces are charged accordingly along with general public parking spaces.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Greensboro Complex is committed to meeting the needs of all guests including those that are hearing impaired, physically challenged or mobility impaired. If you require specific ADA seating accommodations, please call 336-218-5333. If you need other special assistance, please contact our Guest Services Manager at 336-373-7461. Odeon Theater: Accessible seating is located in two sections of the Odeon Theater. Special Events Center: Accessible seating is located on the floor. Visually/Hearing Impaired Seating is available in all venues. Guide dogs are permitted inside Complex facilities. The Complex presently maintains FM assistive listening devices which may be obtained from Guest Services. Interpreters: Interpreters are available for the hearing impaired by arranging for a minimum of 10 days prior to an event to ensure proper service and scheduling. Please call the Coliseum Guest Services Manager at 336-373-7461 to request interpreter services.

generalInfo.generalRule: Greensboro Complex Admission Policies: All persons and items entering the Coliseum Complex facilities are subject to inspection. Visit www.gsocomplex.com for admission info and prohibited items.
generalInfo.childRule: Minimum age for admittance if any: Parents should carefully consider whether a performance is appropriate for children before planning to attend. All events are open to the public and there are no minimum age restrictions. Only specific events will have a minimum age limit which will be communicated in local advertising. Should a young child be unable to sit quietly through a quiet event, ushers will ask the parent or child to step into the concourse until they can be quieted. Minimum age at which paid tickets are mandatory: The general policy is if a child has had their second birthday, a ticket is required. The policy supersedes numbers of seats required (i.e. - a ticket is required regardless of whether the child sits in the seat purchased or the parents lap). Select shows may require tickets for all ages or ages one year old and up to have a ticket. Booster seats are not always available and are subject to use.

events.name: NC State Men's Basketball vs Mississippi State Men's Basketball
events.info: United Sports & Entertainment (@USportsEnt) is proud to announce The Preview (@ThePreviewCBB), an electrifying college basketball exhibition set to take center court on Sunday, October 18, This premier showcase invites basketball fans to get an exciting first look at two of college basketball's elite programs before the start of the regular season, delivering high-level competition and unforgettable moments. The Preview will feature a marquee matchup between the NC State Wolfpack and the Mississippi State Bulldogs. These two programs bring grit, toughness, and talent to what promises to be a thrilling preseason matchup. For NC State fans, this will be the first look at newly-named head coach Justin Gainey, a Wolfpack alum and former star at Greensboro Day School. Mississippi State is looking to make a postseason run as they return one of college basketball?s most electrifying players in Josh Hubbard.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: In advance - Tue-Sat 12pm-5pm Day of Event - Opens at 12pm on event days Summer Hours May Apply.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is located at the venue box office and is available 2 hours prior to performance.

venues.parkingDetail: Event parking is available on site at the Tanger Center, in downtown parking decks and on downtown city streets. Parking rates apply and may vary.

generalInfo.generalRule: All person and items entering the Tanger Center facilities are subject to inspection. For patron protection, visit www.tangercenter.com/plan-your-visit/prohibited items. Smoking is prohibited inside Tanger Center facilities
generalInfo.childRule: All ages require a ticket for entry. Everyone must have a ticket regardless of age, unless otherwise specified by the show. Children must be accompanied by an adult for all performances. Please check with the Steven Tanger Center for the Performing Arts at 336-373-7400 or the show's event page for the age requirements for tickets for the event you are interested in attending. Children under the age of six (6) are not allowed at select STCPA performances including Broadway, Concerts and Comedy shows. Some shows or events do have a different age policy and STCPA will note these on the individual show web page for each event. Family shows such as Disney Live, Paw Patrol and Sesame Street Live may require all children 1 year of age and above to have a ticket. Children must be able to site quietly in their own seat without disturbing other guests. Babies are not recommended. For the comfort and enjoyment of all guests, children who are disruptive to other guests will be asked to leave the auditorium seating area. All sales are final and no refunds will be allowed for removals due to disruption. Some shows do not appeal to every guest or every age. Broadway and other shows offer a varied range of entertainment that could include sudden loud sounds, strobes/flashing lights, adult language, adult situations, or fag and haze. Patrons are responsible for making an informed purchasing decision on show content. Each Broadway touring show has its own website that describes content and age recommendations.
